history.summary: Large 4BR (1389sqft) at OLA EC, Sengkang, at $2.30M / $1,656 PSF — a strong price for a young (2023) 99yr EC and at the upper edge of the liquid band. Excellent Cheng Lim LRT proximity (170m) and on-frontier score, but $2.3M for a Sengkang EC tests the local buyer ceiling.
history.rating_rationale: $1,656 PSF for a 4BR EC is on the higher side for Sengkang and $2.30M sits at the top of where Sengkang EC buyers transact, thinning the resale pool. No URA project rate available (null txns) so appreciation is a regional OCR/EC prior, not project-verified. Score 623 / Elo 1382 with a solid 260-152 record and on-frontier are positives. 170m to Cheng Lim LRT (one stop to Sengkang interchange) is a genuine convenience plus.
red_flags: No URA appreciation data — rate is a regional prior only
$2.3M is near the Sengkang EC price ceiling, narrowing exit pool
$1,656 PSF is rich for a leasehold EC
catalysts: Cheng Lim LRT 170m (Sengkang interchange one stop away)
